structured.answer: I saw that Harel has lots of tracks (105, in 7 kinds). Most charge about half a percent a year from the savings and nothing from deposits, but I couldn't tell which one is as safe as my deposits, so I'm not moving anything until I ask my son or the bank.

stuck.why: I couldn't tell whether it means there is no return, or a small one
Two fees per row. I wasn't sure which one I actually pay

stuck.where: Track names with S&P 500, עוקב מדד, מט"ח
stuck.why: English letters and words I don't know; I couldn't tell which track is safe
Tired of so many numbers on a black screen, so I stopped

used: Heading 'הראל' and the sentence about דמי הניהול
Product buttons with counts (כל המוצרים 105, קופת גמל להשקעה 16, etc.)
Group lines: 'דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.41% עד 0.67%'
skimmed: The many rows of share-heavy tracks
skipped: Top menu (מדריך, השוואה למטרה, השקעה במדד)

A plain sentence saying which track is safe
An explanation of what I would pay in shekels

findings.what: Black background with pale grey small text, hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Whole page, especially column headers and the line under the title

findings.what: Too many numbers per row (two fees, two exposures, two returns, amount); it made me anxious
Nothing says which track is safe or compares it to a deposit
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in place of a return is confusing
Track names in English letters and jargon (S&P 500, עוקב מדד, מט"ח)
Ring charts in close colours I can't tell apart
Big return numbers like 21.47% catch the eye and feel like gambling
Two kinds of fee per row, with no explanation of which one I pay
I don't know the site name 'מקור'; I'm not sure it's official
